description: President of the Ospita association of Swiss private/independent healthcare companies and member of the board of directors of the Kantonsspital Glarus AG. Sits on the Finance Commission of the Council of States, where healthcare financing matters arise.
Employed as Senior Advisor Public Affairs at the Zurich agency IRF Reputation AG, advising corporate clients on political risk and regulation; the specific clients are not publicly disclosed.

Former board member of the Glarner Kantonalbank (2021–2025); former cantonal finance director and member of the Conference of Cantonal Finance Directors (FDK). Described as a fiscally and economically liberal politician with an affinity for finance and tax issues.
Member of the university council (Hochschulrat) of OST – Ostschweizer Fachhochschule.
Member of the foundation board of the Stiftung Konzertsaal und Hotel in Braunwald (Glarus Süd).
